description: This Swift source file extends the ProcessInfo class to add computed properties and methods related to environment detection, application mode (Nix), preview mode, and testing detection. It helps identify the runtime environment and context in which the app or tests are executing.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Extension of the foundation ProcessInfo class to include environment and context detection methods.

methods.name: isPreview
methods.description: Checks if the app is running in Xcode's preview mode by reading the 'XCODE_RUNNING_FOR_PREVIEWS' environment variable.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: Determines if the app is running in Nix mode based on environment variables, user defaults, and whether the app is a bundle.

methods.name: isNixMode
methods.description: Computed property that uses 'resolveNixMode' to check if Nix mode is active.

methods.name: isRunningTests
methods.description: Detects if the current process is a test run by examining loaded bundles and environment variables.
